bio-bot-01-c1.text: Rubinstein CV, Gerrienne P, de la Puente GS, Astini RA, Steemans P (2010). Early Middle Ordovician evidence for land plants in Argentina (eastern Gondwana). New Phytologist 188(2): 365-369.
bio-bot-01-c1.quote: Here, we processed Dapingian (early Middle Ordovician, c. 473-471 Ma) palynological samples from Argentina (eastern Gondwana).
bio-bot-01-c1.claim: Plants colonized land about 470 million years ago.
